about: Plugins with no method-channel default whose iOS and Android classes speak a channel lynkeus_agent stands in for. A host does not run the app's generated plugin registrant, so it sets the class for the platform it plays: lynkeus_headless through the host file the CLI writes (packages/cli/src/commands/flutterHost.ts, HOST_REGISTRATIONS, kept equal to this list by its test), Lynkeus FastSim through the entry fastsim-bundle generates. A registration applies when the plugin and both platform packages are in the app's pubspec.lock.
